implementedControls: login challenges are domain, URI, chain, account, nonce, issue-time, and expiry bound
transaction approval challenges bind one exact intent hash
signature verification is injected for deterministic tests and defaults to viem verifyMessage
replay, expiry, account mismatch, chain mismatch, domain mismatch, URI mismatch, and invalid signatures return explicit reason codes
challenge text states that login does not authorize a transaction and approval does not grant reusable authority
